reuse.why: Extends the existing isMonthFillTarget/getMonthFillCategories/getBudgetData path, but parses the tag with its own regex instead of the tree's extractTagsFromText in shared/tags.ts.

duplication.why: The rule is added once in the shared predicate; the only repetition is the notes join in the two existing queries and a hand-written tag matcher alongside the shared one.

placement.why: The rule sits in isMonthFillTarget in budget/actions.ts, the single place the tree decides which categories month-wide actions fill.

scope.why: Only the predicate, the two feeding queries/types and focused tests change.

maintainability.why: Easy to follow single-point change; the private tag regex can disagree with how the rest of the app recognises tags.

bypasses_abstraction.where: isFixedCostGroup matches #fixed with its own regex instead of shared/tags.ts extractTagsFromText.

disguised_duplication.where: isFixedCostGroup re-expresses tag detection as a bespoke regex rather than calling the shared tag extractor.

one_place.where: isMonthFillTarget in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth directly and by every other month-wide action through getMonthFillCategories.
